claims.verbatim:
Bark Hermine (Dan.), Berg, Port Elizabeth (Algoa Bay), 53 days,
with naval stores, &c. to Sloman & Edye. July 27, lat 18 35 S, long.

no vessels. The H. anchored in the lower bay 10th inst., and came
up to the city to-day.
